text:
laura: Quick sync — AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace preflight. Need asset ownership, trial SKU mapping, EULA, pricing tiers, and telemetry hooks by EOD Tue. Can we list owners? :calendar:

sam: I can own packaging + tech doc. What's the canonical artifact list?

laura: Minimal artifacts: 1) product image (AMI/container), 2) SKU CSV (sku,name,price,trial_duration), 3) EULA PDF, 4) Quickstart + telemetry snippet, 5) Support contact + SLA matrix, 6) legal metadata (jurisdictions).

tanya: Legal: will draft EULA addendum for marketplace-specific terms. Need to know if we expose customer billing data to cloud vendor — confirm.

jess-finance: We need proposed list prices per region + any promotional trial discount. Pinged procurement for VAT guidance. :moneybag:

kevin: I'll add SDK quickstart and example billing tags. Snippet I'll add to docs repo:

kevin: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-1","input":"hello"}'
```

matt: Packaging note: prefer containers for parity, but AWS wants AMI for direct Marketplace listing — we should support both. Will prototype AMI build in CI.

laura: OK matt — ticket me if AMI build needs infra creds. For GCP/Azure we do container images + marketplace manifests.

marketplace-bot: checklist created: marketplace/preflight/1749998765 — assign owners in the playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/marketplace/preflight

sam: timeline check — can legal + finance give sign-off by Tue EOD? If yes, we can file listing by next Fri.

tanya: I can review draft by Mon noon, jess-finance can you confirm pricing by Mon 3pm?

jess-finance: Yes, will confirm by 3pm. Also need to know trial entitlement limits (concurrent seats/token cap).

laura: Proposed trial: 14 days + 10k tokens/day default. If anyone has objections raise now. :eyes:

kevin: fine with that. I'll add entitlements to the quickstart manifest.

sam: I'll slot a canary rollout in Redwood Console after publish to monitor behavior.

laura: Great. Action items: @tanya draft EULA addendum, @jess-finance confirm pricing & entitlements, @matt prototype AMI, @kevin add quickstart + manifest, @sam coordinate rollout. Update playbook when done. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
